digest.component_or_area: Claude Code MCP integration, Serena symbol tools
propositions: Serena symbol tools are deferred by default, requiring a ToolSearch round-trip before use, creating friction asymmetry against non-deferred tools like Bash and grep
ENABLE_TOOL_SEARCH is the only control available; it is global all-or-nothing and cannot limit deferral to specific tools or per-server, so per-tool non-deferral is not implementable
Loading all MCP tool schemas with deferral disabled costs +25k tokens minimum for Serena alone and +64k tokens on a host with four connected servers
A tracked .claude/settings.json with ENABLE_TOOL_SEARCH=false and a negation in .gitignore will un-defer Serena tools with one-line revert capability

The measured token cost (+25k to +64k per session) is bounded, non-compounding, and justified by preventing prior defect cycles, but the dominant cost comes from the operator's total MCP surface, not Serena alone
